messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Sleep log warnings and incomplete output
parts:
Hi Sidney,

To investigate problems with using a sleeplog in GGIR it is best to start with trying to read the sleeplog first with GGIR function g.loadlog only.

For example:
sleeplog = g.loadlog(loglocation="C:/mysleeplog.csv",coln1=2, colid=1,nnights=7,sleeplogidnum=FALSE)
print(head(sleeplog))

If this already leads to warnings it may indicate that either the sleeplog is not in the right format or the arguments like colid, coln1, or sleeplogidnum are not correctly specified.

If this does not lead to warnings then it may be good to double check that the ID numbers in the sleeplog file match the ID numbers in the GGIR part2_summary.csv report.

Best wishes,
Vincent
